# Privacy Policy

Last updated: March 30, 2026

Edition is a personalized daily newspaper platform. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

## What we collect

- Account information — email address, name, timezone, and login credentials (managed by Supabase Auth)
- Preferences — topic interests, delivery schedule, edition configuration
- Usage data — edition generation history, email open tracking (via a 1x1 pixel), and delivery logs
- Payment information — processed by Stripe. We do not store credit card numbers. We receive your subscription status and billing period from Stripe.

## How we use your data

- To generate and deliver your personalized newspaper
- To improve article selection based on your topic preferences
- To send your edition at your chosen delivery time via email
- To process subscription payments
- To monitor service health and fix technical issues

## Third-party services

We use the following services to operate Edition:

- Supabase — authentication, database, and file storage (your account data, preferences, and generated PDFs)
- Resend — email delivery (your email address and edition attachments)
- Stripe — payment processing (your payment method and billing details)
- Anthropic (Claude) — article rewriting and classification (article text only, no personal data)
- Vercel — frontend hosting (standard web server logs)

Terms of Service | Edition

# Terms of Service

Last updated: March 30, 2026

By using Edition, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

## The service

Edition is a personalized newspaper service that selects articles from publicly available news sources, rewrites them to a consistent editorial standard using AI, and delivers them as a formatted newspaper. All articles include attribution to their original source.

## Your account

- You must provide a valid email address to create an account.
- You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure.
- You must not share your account with others.
- You must be at least 13 years old to use Edition.
- Notify us at hello@edition.ink if you suspect unauthorized access to your account.

## Acceptable use

You agree not to:

- Scrape, crawl, or programmatically access the service outside of its intended interface
- Redistribute, republish, or resell edition content
- Use the service for any unlawful purpose
- Attempt to reverse-engineer the service or its underlying algorithms
- Interfere with the service or impose an unreasonable load on our infrastructure

## Content and intellectual property

Edition does not produce original journalism. All news content is sourced from and attributed to its original publishers. Edition rewrites articles for editorial consistency using AI, not to misrepresent their origin. Original sources retain all rights to their reporting.
